dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region contains multiple 'O' shaped structures with well-defined, dark circular perimeters. The transition from the dark exterior boundary to the high-intensity interior is characterized by a sharp, high-contrast gradient approximately 3-5 pixels wide.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: The anterior dorsal region shows a high spatial density of small, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. Core concentration is densest near the pectoral flipper attachment, becoming more sparse and asymmetrical across the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the two most prominent central 'O' rings form a vertical axis. Connecting these centroids with the centroid of the large posterior 'C' shaped structure creates an obtuse triangular geometric relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral flipper exhibits five high-contrast, elongated segments with high-intensity tips, appearing as distinct structural extensions from the dark pelage.
